dedupe_keys.name: annotated rgb oil spill images in port environments

description: The University of Antwerp publishes annotated RGB images of oil spills in a port environment. The Zenodo record supplies an image archive split into training, test and validation subsets using CamVid annotations. The repository metadata identifies a public 2024 release, free under CC BY 4.0, but does not state acquisition dates or a precise geographic extent. These images can train or evaluate detection components used to prepare spill-response and environmental-exposure simulations, with spatial incident review in platform-qgis. A caveat is that image segmentation alone does not estimate released volume, transport through water or cleanup effectiveness. Transfer to other lighting, water and port conditions needs testing. The separately cited code repository does not currently contain the promised trained model. No image archive was downloaded.
